value.rationale: The theorem classifies the full smooth centered coefficient family, exposing six intrinsic Cartier-iterate types and five Jacobian p-rank strata including generic nonordinariness at p=3. It is not an arbitrary small-finite-field census: the proof is uniform over algebraically closed fields and the loci are natural coefficient hyperplanes. The result refines general Hasse–Witt methods by a complete exact small-prime calculation.
